questions.question: The student wants to emphasize the order in which the two students attended the Bauhaus. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
options: Founded in 1919, the Bauhaus was a German art and design school whose past students include Josef Albers and Stella Steyn. 3% 选择
The Bauhaus was founded in 1919, and Stella Steyn began attending in 1931. 4% 选择
Josef Albers and Stella Steyn were both Bauhaus students, but Albers, who began attending in 1920, preceded Steyn. 正确选项 90% 选择
Walter Gropius founded the Bauhaus in 1919 and acted as its director until 1928, at which point Hannes Meyer succeeded him in the role. 3% 选择
